faq.answer1: A share in a Blue Chip Artwork lets you benefit from its value growth and sell it anytime as a liquid asset. For 20+ years, Blue Chip art has outperformed the S&P 500.
faq.answer2: The first 3M of 100M shares are available now through SAFT contracts. Buying today at a 66% discount, you’ll receive them in your personal wallet on the FracTown RWA Platform.
faq.answer3: On CoArt Marketplace you can trade both entire physical assets and fractional shares via our FCC (Fractional Crypto Certificate), almost as instantly as NFTs.
faq.answer4: Ownership rights will be split into 300 lots, each with different share amounts. The auction runs for two weeks in early December, open to retail investors worldwide.
faq.answer5: After the auction, it will be placed in a European museum or freeport vault. FracTown will retain 3% of the shares to manage the asset, while the remaining shares will trade freely on CoArt Marketplace.
